headline: Meta Opens a Mature React Design System
lede: Astryx brings more than 150 accessible React components, themes, templates, and dark-mode primitives to teams building on React 19 and StyleX. Its typed APIs, CSS-variable theming, and ejectable components keep the visual system adaptable instead of locking products into one styling stack.

headline: Anthropic Packages Expertise for Claude
lede: Anthropic’s skills repository treats agent behavior as an installable system of procedures, metadata, examples, and supporting tools. The collection turns document production, enterprise communication, development, and analysis into repeatable workflows that teams can inspect, adapt, and test.

headline: A Disciplined Lifecycle for Coding Agents
lede: Agent Skills gives coding agents a construction plan: specify the work, make a design, implement it, test it, review it, and ship it. Its 25 Markdown workflows encode checkpoints and anti-rationalization rules across tools including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Copilot.

headline: Claude Quickstarts Map the Route to Production
lede: This reference collection assembles working patterns for customer support, financial analysis, browser automation, computer control, and autonomous coding. Retrieval, persistent sessions, event-driven workflows, credential vaults, and human review give teams infrastructure to study before they build their own Claude-powered services.

headline: MuJoCo Makes Contact Dynamics Computable
lede: MuJoCo models articulated systems through a low-level C API, preallocated state, and an XML compiler built for fast, repeatable simulation. Robotics, biomechanics, graphics, and reinforcement-learning researchers get Python bindings, browser visualization, Unity integration, and accelerated differentiable workflows without sacrificing control over the engine.

headline: Sure Rebuilds Wealth Management in the Open
lede: Sure carries the useful parts of the abandoned Maybe Finance project into a self-hostable personal-finance platform. Docker deployment, PostgreSQL, mobile and desktop clients, and optional AI features let households track money while keeping their financial records under their own control.

headline: HA-MCP Gives Home Assistant a Conversational Control Plane
lede: HA-MCP routes natural-language requests from Claude, ChatGPT, and other assistants into Home Assistant through the Model Context Protocol. Secure webhooks, local endpoints, configurable tools, backups, and authentication connect household automation to an extensible stream of context and commands.

headline: A Rust CLI Gives Agents a Browser Handle
lede: agent-browser reduces a webpage to an accessibility tree that an agent can inspect and operate from the shell. Stable element references, persistent sessions, screenshots, downloads, authentication, and Chrome DevTools control make browser work feel like a practical terminal pipeline rather than a fragile DOM hunt.

headline: Sherlock Searches the Web for One Handle
lede: Sherlock checks hundreds of public services for a supplied username, revealing where an identity may be reused across social, developer, and community platforms. Its Python CLI supports filters, exports, proxies, and batch searches for researchers, investigators, and people auditing their own digital footprint.

headline: Topcoat Experiments with Full-Stack Rust
lede: Topcoat bundles server rendering, reactive components, routing, sessions, asset handling, and Tailwind integration into one experimental Rust framework. Its type-checked views can render on the server and update in the browser, sketching a path to interactive applications without a separate JavaScript build system.
